summary: Preinstall drops Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated 727KB payload in a Vue UI package
details: The preinstall script setup.mjs downloads the Bun runtime from github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases, extracts it to a temp directory, chmods it executable, and uses it to execFileSync the sibling file math_init.js. math_init.js is a 727KB obfuscator.io-style bundle (shuffled constant array, array-rotation function, custom base64 alphabet decoder, single-line minification) that is not listed in the package.json files manifest and bears no relationship to the package's declared Vue step-chooser UI purpose. setup.mjs itself is obfuscated with hex-prefixed identifiers and object-wrapped constant indirection to disguise the fetch/exec flow. Installing this package causes an opaque payload to execute on the installer's machine under a runtime the package fetches specifically to bypass Node-based inspection. This is the alternate-runtime-dropper pattern: while bun.sh is Bun's official domain, the runtime is being used to run a bundled opaque payload rather than the package's own declared library code, and the loader is deliberately obfuscated.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
